import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    return (params[0] + params[1]*P + params[2]*P**2 + params[3]/P + params[4]*t/P + params[5]*t**2/P
            + params[6]*P*np.log(P) + params[7]*t*P*np.log(P) + params[8]*np.log(t)*P + params[9]*t)
